summary: F2 is resolved. The new page test runs the query function and checks that the page redeems the `#handoff=` fragment before it reads the setup, and removes the fragment from the URL. The coverage gate still fails on two lines in mountHaloApp.tsx (30-31): the exemption marker is a JSX comment on a line of its own, so the report does not apply it to the `<HaloAppRoutes host={host} />` line.

findings.body: The coverage-exempt marker is a JSX comment on its own line (line 30). The report therefore counts line 30 and the element line 31, `<HaloAppRoutes host={host} />`, as uncovered, and the gate fails. Put the marker on the same line as the element, for example `<HaloAppRoutes host={host} /> {/* coverage-exempt: mount shell; HaloAppRoutes is tested directly */}`, and remove the separate comment line. The reason is acceptable. Alternatively, add a temp test that calls mountHaloApp.
